scope: one profile and one native output pixel; the same algebra is applied independently to Uniform, Raw, Fine and Medium

input_per_frame_internal_subpixel.geometry_b: sum of positive geometric droplet overlaps before source validity
input_per_frame_internal_subpixel.source_b: sum of overlaps with finite, sensor-valid, radiometrically usable source samples
input_per_frame_internal_subpixel.estimator_b: source weight admitted by the selected or fallback estimator; Gate 3 supplies it

support_contract.geometry_support: at least one internal subpixel has geometry_b > 0 in at least one frame
support_contract.source_support: at least one internal subpixel has source_b > 0 in at least one frame
support_contract.estimator_support: at least one internal subpixel has estimator_b > 0 in at least one frame
support_contract.nonfinite_policy: a nonfinite numerator with a positive corresponding denominator is invalid; zero denominators carry no value

partial_area_contract.value_rule: if profile B_out > 0, value_out = A_out / B_out regardless of missing internal subpixels
partial_area_contract.area_fractions: geometry, source, estimator and profile area fractions are reported independently as the sum of native area factors for internal subpixels supported by at least one frame, divided by total area
partial_area_contract.delivery_gate: Gate 2 does not erase a finite partial-area estimate; later confidence may use the fractions, while a final delivery threshold requires a separate explicit contract
partial_area_contract.area_requirements: all area factors are finite and nonnegative and total area is positive

forbidden_equations: profile support = AND of all internal subpixel supports

exact_cpu_cases: constant field with full and partial area
linear gradient with unequal area and profile weights
cuda_oracle_cases: all four support layer combinations allowed by implication
